title: AdPulse
tagline: PySpark marketing & revenue analytics — segmentation, A/B testing & BI (real data)
highlights: PySpark ELT over 1.07M real retail-transaction rows (Online Retail II, UCI), quarantining 2.4% genuinely dirty records (cancellations, non-positive qty/price) and computing revenue/AOV by country/month via Spark SQL window functions.
Validated a real marketing A/B experiment (ad vs PSA control) with a two-proportion z-test — +43% conversion lift (p<1e-12) — plus a chi-square cross-check and power analysis.
Segmented 5,878 customers via RFM + K-Means (k=2 by silhouette 0.44), isolating a 2,332-strong Champions cohort (£6.5K avg lifetime value).
